verdict.rationale: Omnara is a control/orchestration layer for launching, monitoring, and messaging agents (via CLI/API/dashboard, connecting to your own machine or model), but nothing in the evidence describes a sandboxed or isolated execution environment for code/dependency installation—agents appear to run on a user-connected machine or laptop/server without mention of isolation, containerization, or sandboxing guarantees. missing for 10: any mention of sandbox/isolation architecture, dependency installation safety, or containerized execution environment.
